summary.relationship to the delta: I grew up in [redacted], and my dad had a boat, and we used to fish in the Delta all the time. Most recently, I have been running a program called [redacted] focused on intensive farming classes. The Delta is a unique, highly productive place with innovative farming practices. I have deep concerns about the Delta decision-making processes, particularly regarding salinity management and adaptation to climate change. I have observed a lack of listening and inclusion in decision-making, with a focus on environmental goals over the value of farmland and food production. I advocate for a more balanced approach that considers the needs of farmers, communities, and the environment, emphasizing compromise and community engagement for equitable outcomes. I highlight the importance of managing for worst-case scenarios and investigating severe conservation measures to address salinity and water management challenges.
